# sophosfirewall_fqdn_group (Resource)

Manages an FQDN address group (*Objects > Hosts and services > FQDN host group*). Groups can be referenced from firewall and NAT rules wherever a single host can.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_fqdn_address" "updates" {
  name = "vendor-updates"
  fqdn = "*.updates.example.com"
}

resource "sophosfirewall_fqdn_address" "cdn" {
  name = "vendor-cdn"
  fqdn = "cdn.example.com"
}

resource "sophosfirewall_fqdn_group" "vendor" {
  name        = "vendor-services"
  description = "Hosts the vendor software needs to reach"
  addresses = [
    sophosfirewall_fqdn_address.updates.name,
    sophosfirewall_fqdn_address.cdn.name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the FQDN address group.

### Optional

- `addresses` (Set of String) Names of the FQDN address objects (`sophosfirewall_fqdn_address`) in the group. Membership is unordered. Omit it for an empty group.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_fqdn_group.example <name-or-uuid>
```
